As part of our routine sign-off process, I'd like to go through each function area before I approve and issue the final term sheet. We have a preliminary proposal with a four-year tenor, a 2% reserve, a 5% delinquency trigger, monthly servicer remittances, and no special note-rating condition. I need each of you — legal, credit risk, investor coverage, and loan operations — to state any condition that must be reflected in the term sheet before I give my approval. Let's start with legal.
